Equal Treatment Bench Book – July 2024 (May 2025 update) 146
The youth justice system

50. The National Audit Office found that 53% of children in custody were from ethnic minority
groups.412 The report proceeded to note that approximately 33% had a diagnosed mental
disorder, and that many had learning difficulties.
